sanskrit_verse:
विहिताकरणान् नित्यं प्रतिषिद्धनिषेवणात ।
भक्ताच्छादं प्रदायैषां शेषं गृह्णीत पार्थिवः ॥ १,१.१३१
transliteration: vihitākaraṇān nityaṃ pratiṣiddhaniṣevaṇāt | bhaktācchādaṃ pradāyaiṣāṃ śeṣaṃ gṛhṇīta pārthivaḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: The ruler must always receive the residue of duties unperformed due to persistent transgression of prohibitions, after offering the covering of devotion to those very transgressors.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from alignment with Dharma, not coercion
Causation is rooted in conscious omission, not mere action
Capacity-based responsibility requires restoration of integrity
Restoration logic demands reintegration through devotional offering
executable_legal_axioms: IF a subject persistently omits prescribed duties THEN ruler assumes residue responsibilities
IF transgression occurs THEN prior offering of bhakti-integrity must precede administrative receipt of consequence
IF duty omission traced to misaligned consciousness THEN restoration protocol overrides punitive measures
IF subject shows capacity for realignment THEN residue duty absorption by ruler becomes mandatory
supreme_court_application: In Supreme adjudication, when omissions stem from systemic neglect or conscious defiance of dharmic injunctions, the sovereign must absorb residual obligations only after facilitating devotional reorientation of the actor. The court must ensure that offerings of bhakti precede any assumption of liability.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Through pramāṇa-based discernment, it is seen that unperformed duties arise from veiled consciousness. By sequential manifestation (anupūrvaśaḥ), the covering of devotion removes distortion before consequences are assumed. Responsibility aligns proportionally with awareness, never imposing suffering as corrective.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Facilitate performance of omitted duties through guided alignment
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Ruler absorbs residue only post-devotional clearing
Capacity Restoration Mechanism: Reintegrate subject via bhakti-centered engagement
Integrity Reintegration Sequence: Offer protective covering before assigning consequence
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law executes Dharma as restoration, establishes Consciousness as the Supreme Adjudicator, affirms reality as non-punitive, and declares the Sovereign as absorber of karmic residue through devotion-based realignment.
